chatters.title: Chatters
chatters.description: Your chatters. Those with access to this agent are listed first; grant any other chatter access in one click.
chatters.public_description: Anyone with the link can chat with this agent, so chatter grants don't apply. To use chatters, make the agent protected from its Security tab.
chatters.empty_description: Invite someone to get started — they'll show up here.
chatters.no_results_title: No chatters found matching your search.
chatters.invite_dialog_description: We'll email a sign-up link to this address. They can set a password or sign in with Google or Slack.
chatters.invitation_emailed: Invitation emailed to {email}. You can also copy the link below.
chatters.sheet_description: Chatter details and access for this agent.
chatters.invitation_pending_hint: This chatter hasn't accepted yet. Share their personal sign-up link below.
chatters.link_expired: The invitation link has expired or is no longer available. Generate a fresh one below.
chatters.manage_hint: To manage this chatter, go to the {link}.
chatters.revoke_dialog_description: {name} will lose access to this agent immediately. They stay in your workspace and you can grant access again at any time.
chatters.access_revoked: {name} no longer has access to this agent
chatters.access_granted: {name} now has access to this agent
chatters.link_error: Could not generate an invitation link
